title: UserEditDialog Component + i18n Dict Keys
content:
Create the UserEditDialog component and add required dictionary keys for all three locales.

## UserEditDialog
A dialog/side-panel component for editing user profile fields.

### Editable fields:
- nameZh (text input, required)
- nameEn (text input, required)
- email (text input, required, email validation)
- phone (text input, required, phone validation)
- iaLicense (text input, optional)
- idDocNumber (text input, optional)
- idDocType (select: HKID/PASSPORT/PERMIT/OTHER, optional)
- organization (text input, optional)
- isMember (checkbox, optional)
- memberId (text input, optional, shown only when isMember checked)

### Read-only display fields:
- role (display only, no edit)
- createdAt (display only)

### States:
- Loading: skeleton placeholders while fetching user data
- Saving: spinner on save button, fields disabled
- Success: toast notification, dialog closes
- Error: toast notification with error message
- Validation: inline error messages on each field

## i18n
Add a userEdit section to AdminDict with keys:
- title (edit user)
- nameZh.label, nameZh.error (required)
- nameEn.label, nameEn.error
- email.label, email.error (invalid format)
- phone.label, phone.error (invalid format)
- iaLicense.label
- idDocNumber.label
- idDocType.label, idDocType.options.HKID/PASSPORT/PERMIT/OTHER
- organization.label
- isMember.label
- memberId.label
- role.label
- createdAt.label
- save / saving / saveSuccess / saveError
- loading / loadingError

Does NOT wire into users page — that is AD-008-3.

evidence.residual: Integration into users page happens in AD-008-3.

acceptance: UserEditDialog renders all editable fields (nameZh, nameEn, email, phone, iaLicense, idDocNumber, idDocType, organization, isMember, memberId)
UserEditDialog shows role and createdAt as read-only
Email validation works with inline error message
Phone validation works with inline error message
nameZh/nameEn show required validation error when empty
idDocType is a select with HKID/PASSPORT/PERMIT/OTHER options
memberId input appears/disappears based on isMember checkbox
Loading state shows skeleton while fetching
Saving state shows spinner on save button
All labels use dict keys (en, zh-hk, zh-cn)
npm run typecheck && npm run lint pass
dependencies: AD-008-1 provides the API routes (GET + PATCH) that this component calls.
verification: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && render component in isolation with mock API, verify all states (loading/saving/success/error/validation).
